plain_english_policy: This bill directs the Alabama Legislature to provide a specific financial appropriation of $9,703,990 from the Education Trust Fund to Tuskegee University for fiscal year 2011. The policy direction establishes that because Tuskegee has a unique historical relationship with the state (founded by legislative act in 1881 and incorporated separately), it should be funded differently than standard private schools or public universities. Crucially, the bill attaches strict administrative conditions to this funding: no money can be released until an operations plan is approved and audited financial statements for the prior year are submitted. Furthermore, the university must submit quarterly reports on actual spending versus plans, along with a final end-of-year performance report detailing costs and meaningful measures of effectiveness.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would result in an immediate transfer of $9,703,990 to Tuskegee University for educational support. It codifies the requirement that at least $1,414,586 must be used specifically for agricultural research and extension service state matches. The policy enforces a rigorous oversight framework where funds are held in abeyance until compliance with reporting requirements (operations plan approval, audited statements) is met by the Director of Finance.
sponsorship_supports_position: The sponsors affirmatively advanced an act to appropriate funds with specific conditions. They support funding Tuskegee University under a unique status distinct from other institutions and require strict financial reporting before fund release.
evidence_quotes: "To make an appropriation of $9,703,990 from the Education Trust Fund to Tuskegee University... for the support and maintenance of the educational program of the institution"

"Tuskegee Institute was established by an act of the Legislature in 1881... it is deemed that Tuskegee University should be funded accordingly and not as the private schools and colleges nor as the state public colleges and universities are funded."
"Prior to the release of any funds appropriated under this act the following reports shall be submitted: (1) An operations plan... (2) An audited financial statement"
